request: Deployment approval agent. When the user writes 'deploy <service> to <env>', reply with the text 'Approval needed: <service> -> <env>' and a review card with an Approve button (selection {"action":"approve","service":"<service>"}) and a Reject button (selection {"action":"reject","service":"<service>"}). When it receives the approve selection JSON, reply 'Deployment of <service> approved'. On reject, reply 'Deployment of <service> cancelled'. Otherwise reply 'Usage: deploy <service> to <env>'.
